original_request: عايز أصلح تشغيل الشبكة الإحداثية وتسميات خطوط الطول ودوائر العرض والمبالغة الرأسية في برنامج ZEarth
assumptions: البرنامج يستخدم محرك عرض للكرة الأرضية؛ يجب فحص المحرك الفعلي قبل اختيار الأدوات

tasks.title: Graticule toggle and scale-aware labels
tasks.description: Make graticule on/off independent from place-name labels; support coordinate labels and LOD when requested.
acceptance_criteria: Both grid and coordinate label controls respond in the running application
Grid labels appear at documented zoom levels, persist across view changes

tasks.title: Live terrain exaggeration
tasks.description: Wire a user-adjustable, saved 3D terrain vertical exaggeration to the real renderer without changing source DEM Z.
acceptance_criteria: Changing exaggeration causes a visible scene update on a known high-relief DEM
Switching 2D/3D and reopening the project preserves the chosen value

tasks.title: Regression and evidence
tasks.description: Run feature and integration tests, record native-run evidence or explicitly report unavailable tests.
acceptance_criteria: Regression suite recorded with passed/failed/blocked statuses
T0–T4 acceptance evidence and rollback notes produced
